description: This file defines the internal server logic for the github-mcp-server, including server configuration, client setup, middleware, and server startup functions. It manages GitHub API interactions, server initialization, and command handling via stdio.

classes.name: MCPServerConfig
classes.description: Configuration struct for initializing the MCP server, including version, host, token, toolsets, and logging options.

classes.name: StdioServerConfig
classes.description: Configuration struct for running the server in stdio mode, including command logging, translation export, and lockdown options.

classes.name: apiHost
classes.description: Struct holding URLs for various GitHub API endpoints based on host type.

methods.name: NewMCPServer
methods.description: Creates and configures a new MCP server instance based on provided configuration, setting up clients, middleware, and toolsets.

methods.name: RunStdioServer
methods.description: Runs the MCP server in stdio mode, handling signals, logging, and server lifecycle management.

methods.name: newDotcomHost
methods.description: Returns URLs for GitHub.com API endpoints.

methods.name: newGHECHost
methods.description: Returns URLs for GitHub Enterprise Cloud host based on hostname.

methods.name: newGHESHost
methods.description: Returns URLs for GitHub Enterprise Server host, considering subdomain isolation.

methods.name: checkSubdomainIsolation
methods.description: Checks if GHES has subdomain isolation enabled by pinging the raw.<host>/_ping endpoint.

methods.name: parseAPIHost
methods.description: Parses a host string and returns corresponding API URLs based on host type.

methods.name: addGitHubAPIErrorToContext
methods.description: Middleware that adds GitHub error handling to the context.

methods.name: addUserAgentsMiddleware
methods.description: Middleware that sets User-Agent headers for API requests during initialization.
